routes.name: Residence permit for work requiring expert knowledge

note: Iceland, read on Ísland.is (the government's portal, the Directorate of Immigration's and Registers Iceland's pages) on 2026-10-30. A performer with a job offer takes a residence permit based on work: for work requiring expert knowledge (others are for labour shortages, athletes and service contracts); the application costs ISK 80,000; the permit is granted for up to four years, never past the work permit's validity, and renewed for up to four years at a time; its holder may work only for the employer the work permit was granted to (work for the sponsor); an applicant for this permit may be in Iceland while it is processed (either). Citizens of the EEA and EFTA states and Switzerland staying beyond three months register with Registers Iceland (Nordic citizens on a page of their own, not read), up to ten working days after the documents are in. A permanent residence permit asks four years' continuous residence on a permit that can be its basis, which the expert-knowledge permit is (4 kept); ISK 60,000 for an adult; it's decided more slowly than a renewal, no time given. Naturalisation's years weren't read, so no route is marked as counting.

sources.title: Ísland.is (Directorate of Immigration), Residence and work permits
sources.said: For work requiring expert knowledge Due to a shortage of labour For athletes On the basis of a collaboration or service contract ... The fee for an application is 80.000 ISK . ... Applicants for residence permits for work requiring expert knowledge may be present in Iceland when the application is submitted and while it is being processed

sources.title: Ísland.is (Directorate of Immigration), Residence and work permits: rights and obligations
sources.said: Residence permit for work requiring expert knowledge The permit may be granted for up to four years, however, not longer than the period of validity of the work permit. The holder may not work for an employer other than the one to whom the work permit was granted. ... The permit may be renewed for up to four years at a time, if the conditions of the permit are still fulfilled, however, not longer than the period of validity of the work permit.

sources.title: Ísland.is (Registers Iceland), Registration of EEA/EFTA citizens at Registers Iceland
sources.said: Foreign nationals from EEA/EFTA states who stay in Iceland longer than three months must register with Registers Iceland. ... Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Portugal, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and Switzerland. ... General processing time can take up to ten working days after all necessary documentation has been received.

sources.title: Ísland.is (Directorate of Immigration), Permanent residence permit
sources.said: The fee is 60.000 ISK for adults and 30.000 ISK for children under 18.

sources.title: Ísland.is (Directorate of Immigration), Permanent residence permit: requirements
sources.said: Residence permit for work requiring expert knowledge. ... a foreign national must have resided in Iceland on a residence permit that can be the basis of a permanent residence permit for four years continuously.
